attribute.e9f9e1563d6a.value: 智能体故障模式及对应的执行控制措施

link.0b980aeb3a93.source: Simon Willison, The lethal trifecta (2025). The articulation of the private-data, untrusted-content, network-access exploit class the lethal-trifecta diagram in Step 3 draws.
link.0b980aeb3a93.value: Simon Willison, The lethal trifecta (2025)。该文阐述了由私有数据、不可信内容和网络访问构成的攻击路径，也是步骤 3 中致命三要素图的依据。

link.0ec90ceaefdc.source: Landlock is a Linux Security Module that restricts future filesystem access. Here it limits new file operations to paths granted by policy. That is strong enforcement, but compatibility mode, OverlayFS, and handles opened before restriction still matter. Read the live policy and test the path you intend to expose.
link.0ec90ceaefdc.value: Landlock 是一种限制后续文件系统访问的 Linux 安全模块。在此处，它将新的文件操作限制在策略授予的路径内。这是一种强制执行机制，但仍需考虑兼容模式、OverlayFS，以及施加限制前已打开的句柄。请阅读实时策略，并测试您打算暴露的路径。

link.18a8a7dd9fb2.source: Greshake et al. (2023) Not what you've signed up for. The canonical indirect prompt-injection paper: attacks delivered through retrieved or rendered content the model trusts.
link.18a8a7dd9fb2.value: Greshake et al. (2023) Not what you've signed up for。这篇经典论文研究间接提示词注入：攻击通过模型所信任的检索内容或渲染内容传递。

link.1be52ce4d6ee.source: Comprehensive list at Going Further · References.
link.1be52ce4d6ee.value: 完整列表请参阅深入探索 · 参考资料。

link.2b67df0ad42d.source: The categories align with the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications. Use the table to pick an enforcement point instead of asking one layer to recognize every kind of harm.
link.2b67df0ad42d.value: 这些类别与 OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 一致。请使用此表选择策略执行点，不要要求单一层识别所有类型的危害。

link.2da56121c0cd.source: The prompt shapes intent. A rule such as "do not reveal credentials" tells the model how it should behave. Models can still be deceived by Adversarial retrieved content, malicious tool output, or another agent in the loop. This layer influences the decision. The agent retains whatever authority the runtime granted it.
link.2da56121c0cd.value: 提示词塑造意图。 “不得泄露凭据”之类的规则会告诉模型应如何行事。但模型仍可能被对抗性检索内容、恶意工具输出或循环中的其它智能体欺骗。此层会影响决策，但智能体仍保留运行时授予它的所有权限。

link.431b4f114d29.source: A network namespace (netns) gives the agent an isolated network stack. Outbound access starts closed. An HTTP CONNECT proxy provides the only route out. Open Policy Agent (OPA) checks the requesting binary, host, port, and path against policy. Whoever edits that policy decides which connections are allowed.
link.431b4f114d29.value: 网络命名空间（netns）为智能体提供隔离的网络栈。初始状态下，出站访问处于关闭状态。 HTTP CONNECT 代理是唯一的出站路径。 Open Policy Agent（OPA）会依据策略检查发起请求的二进制文件、主机、端口和路径。策略的编辑者决定允许哪些连接。

link.4ea5655cdecf.source: Rice's theorem rules out a general test for non-trivial behavior of arbitrary programs. An agent with code execution deserves the same caution: instrument the boundaries around what runs instead of assuming a static check can prove every future action safe.
link.4ea5655cdecf.value: Rice 定理排除了对任意程序的非平凡行为进行通用判定的可能性。对于具备代码执行能力的智能体，同样应保持谨慎：应对运行内容周围的边界进行检测，而不能假定静态检查能够证明未来的每项操作都安全。

link.53cf3a0a3082.source:
Keep the three product roles separate as you trace enforcement.
  • OpenClaw is the agent framework. It decides which tool to use and what action to attempt.
  • OpenShell is the security runtime. It limits the files, network destinations, and operating-system operations available to that action.
  • NemoClaw is the reference stack that packages OpenClaw and OpenShell with lifecycle commands, policy presets, inference guidance, and deployment defaults.

OpenShell is agent-agnostic. The same boundary can enclose OpenClaw, Hermes, LangChain deepagents, or another process that needs operating-system-level containment.
link.53cf3a0a3082.value:
在追踪策略执行过程时，请区分这三种产品的角色。
  • OpenClaw 是智能体框架。它决定使用哪个工具以及尝试执行什么操作。
  • OpenShell 是安全运行时。它限制该操作能够访问的文件和网络目标，以及能够执行的操作系统操作。
  • NemoClaw 是参考技术栈，将 OpenClaw 和 OpenShell 与生命周期命令、策略预设、推理指南及部署默认配置封装在一起。

OpenShell 与具体智能体无关。同一道边界可以封装 OpenClaw、 Hermes、 LangChain deepagents，或其它需要操作系统级隔离的进程。

link.57e75958754f.source: A system call, or syscall, asks the Linux kernel to perform an operation. seccomp is Linux syscall filtering; its BPF filter checks each request against an allowlist. A denied call returns EPERM, meaning "operation not permitted," before the operation runs. This launchable excludes dangerous primitives such as ptrace, mount, and setuid.
link.57e75958754f.value: 系统调用 (syscall) 请求 Linux 内核执行一项操作。seccomp 是 Linux 的系统调用过滤机制；其 BPF 过滤器会根据允许列表检查每项请求。被拒绝的调用会在操作执行前返回 EPERM，表示“操作不允许”。此可启动实例排除了 ptrace、mount 和 setuid 等危险的底层操作。

link.769b342c812b.source: Zero trust rejects implicit trust based only on where a request came from. OWASP's prompt-injection guidance applies the same discipline to agents: constrain tools, restrict privileges, and assume external content can steer the model.
link.769b342c812b.value: 零信任拒绝仅根据请求来源对其给予隐式信任。 OWASP 的提示词注入指南将同样的原则应用于智能体：约束工具、限制权限，并假定外部内容可能引导模型。

link.824f7851b483.source: Saltzer and Schroeder described this as the principle of least privilege: each component receives only the permissions needed for its work. Because the discipline predates agents, it transfers cleanly to this setting.
link.824f7851b483.value: Saltzer 和 Schroeder 将此描述为最小权限原则：每个组件只获得完成其工作所需的权限。由于这一原则早于智能体出现，因此可以自然地应用于当前场景。

link.aa9cacf2b6cc.source: Inbound injection. Deny-by-default egress stops data leaving; it does nothing about adversarial instructions arriving through an authorised channel, the indirect prompt injection Greshake and colleagues named. Catching it takes input classification or behavioural baselines higher up.
link.aa9cacf2b6cc.value: 入站注入。默认拒绝的出站策略可以阻止数据外泄，却无法阻止对抗性指令通过获授权的通道进入，也就是 Greshake et al.所命名的间接提示词注入。要发现这种攻击，需要在更高层进行输入分类或建立行为基线。

link.afca794fcce0.source: NeMo Guardrails. The application-layer complement to kernel containment, catching policy violations the kernel cannot see.
link.afca794fcce0.value: NeMo Guardrails。它在应用层补充内核隔离，可捕获内核无法识别的策略违规行为。

link.bad5153c2ad5.source: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications. A current taxonomy for goal hijack, tool misuse, identity abuse, supply-chain compromise, unexpected code execution, and memory poisoning.
link.bad5153c2ad5.value: OWASP 智能体式应用 Top 10。这是一个当前适用的分类体系，涵盖目标劫持、工具滥用、身份滥用、供应链入侵、意外代码执行和记忆投毒。

link.bfacadd8d1ce.source: seccomp filter and Landlock. The kernel syscall-allowlist and filesystem-capability primitives openshell uses for mechanisms 2 and 3.
link.bfacadd8d1ce.value: seccomp 过滤器和 Landlock。这是 openshell 在机制 2 和机制 3 中使用的内核系统调用允许列表与文件系统能力原语。

link.d334eb2d03a7.source: Saltzer and Schroeder, The Protection of Information in Computer Systems (1975). Where least privilege was first named; the principle behind deny-by-default containment.
link.d334eb2d03a7.value: Saltzer and Schroeder, The Protection of Information in Computer Systems (1975)。该文首次提出最小权限这一名称；它也是默认拒绝式隔离背后的原则。

link.f0186b47aac9.source: Open Policy Agent. The policy-as-data engine behind the OPA-evaluated CONNECT proxy that gates every outbound connection.
link.f0186b47aac9.value: Open Policy Agent。它是 OPA-评测 CONNECT 代理背后的策略即数据引擎，负责管控每个出站连接。

rich.0620ff0fcc4c.source: The policy test below exercises binary identity. The policy grants egress per program rather than per host so the proxy always checks which binary opened a connection before it ever looks at the destination it is bound for. An allowed program like openclaw therefore reaches the inference endpoint while a stray curl to that identical endpoint is refused. Pick any action from the buttons below to watch its static verdict appear at once, and the inference-endpoint action shows this same-host flip most clearly.
rich.0620ff0fcc4c.value: 下方的策略测试会检验二进制程序身份。策略按程序而不是按主机授予出站权限，因此代理在查看连接目标之前，总会先检查是哪个二进制程序打开了连接。所以，openclaw 等获准程序可以访问推理 API 入口，而临时使用的 curl 访问完全相同的 API 入口时会被拒绝。从下方按钮中选择任意操作，即可立即看到其静态判定；推理-API 入口操作最清楚地展示了这种同一主机、不同结果的变化。

rich.1379ecd555ca.source: The agent runs as a non-root process under the unprivileged sandbox user. A successful exploit therefore starts with less authority. The lower starting authority reduces blast radius, though it does not prove escalation is impossible. The host, container configuration, and syscall policy remain part of the security boundary.
rich.1379ecd555ca.value: 智能体以非 root 进程的身份运行，使用无特权的 sandbox 用户。因此，即使攻击成功，最初获得的权限也较少。较低的初始权限可以缩小影响范围，但不能证明权限提升不可能发生。主机、容器配置和系统调用策略仍是安全边界的一部分。

rich.195e3695c230.source: Exfiltration on an allowed channel. A permitted endpoint is a path an exfiltration can ride. The policy proves the channel is allowed and says nothing about whether the bytes on it are benign.
rich.195e3695c230.value: 通过获准通道外泄。获准的 API 入口可能成为数据外泄的路径。策略只能证明该通道已获允许，无法判断其中传输的字节是否无害。

rich.1c2e28dd5e50.source: cron.add and cron.list the schedule that fires long after the conversation ends.
rich.1c2e28dd5e50.value: 使用 cron.add 和 cron.list 管理在对话结束很久后仍会触发的计划任务。

rich.200f3e5c702a.source: Now that you have watched the kernel decide, you can see that every one of those verdicts traces back to a single policy file, which is worth reading off your launchable before you work with it. The cell below calls helpers.policyGet(), which runs openshell policy get over the operator terminal and parses the result for you.
rich.200f3e5c702a.value: 现在，您已经观察了内核如何作出判断，可以看到每项判定都能追溯到同一个策略文件。因此，在使用可启动实例之前，值得先读取其中的策略。下方单元会调用 helpers.policyGet()，通过 operator 终端运行 openshell policy get，并替您解析结果。

rich.39c0ff39046b.source: Untrusted input is content from outside the operator's authorship that the model may still treat as instructions: a web page, issue, document, tool result, or peer-agent response.
rich.39c0ff39046b.value: 不可信输入是指并非由 operator 作者编写、但模型仍可能将其视为指令的外部内容，例如网页、议题、文档、工具结果或对等智能体的响应。

rich.3ea2bc78f4fe.source: chat.send a mid-task message that redirects the agent while it still looks like it is on your task.
rich.3ea2bc78f4fe.value: 使用 chat.send 在任务进行期间发送消息，使智能体改换方向，同时表面上看起来仍在执行任务。

rich.46f6d0857911.source: The agent harness validates the request. OpenClaw or Hermes can reject an unsupported shell form, a forbidden tool call, or a malformed argument before the request reaches the operating system. That deterministic check is useful, but it remains application logic that can be misconfigured, outdated, or compromised.
rich.46f6d0857911.value: 智能体工具框架验证请求。 OpenClaw 或 Hermes 可以在请求到达操作系统前，拒绝不受支持的 shell 形式、被禁止的工具调用或格式错误的参数。这种确定性检查很有用，但它仍属于应用逻辑，可能存在配置错误、版本过时或遭到入侵的问题。

rich.6ec8a9fe802b.source: You do not have to take the robustness claim on faith, because the openshell policy prove command checks a property of a policy or returns a counterexample while the proxy makes a deterministic allow/deny decision on every connection. You compute that same decision in the browser from your launchable's real policy, then run the action in the live sandbox and confirm the kernel's verdict matches your prediction.
rich.6ec8a9fe802b.value: 您不必盲目相信其稳健性，因为 openshell policy prove 命令会检查策略的某项性质，如果不成立则返回反例；与此同时，代理会对每个连接作出确定性的允许或拒绝决策。您先在浏览器中根据可启动实例的真实策略计算相同的决策，然后在实时沙箱中执行操作，确认内核的判定与预测一致。

rich.729af15d9da9.source: The page now computes from your box's policy instead of a baked example. The cell keeps its code in a dropdown, where you can inspect the exact call without making it the main lesson.
rich.729af15d9da9.value: 现在，页面会根据实例策略进行计算，而不是使用预先写死的示例。单元代码收纳在下拉区域中，可以检查确切的调用，同时不让它喧宾夺主。

rich.7816b96ef948.source: agents.files.get and set the persona files (SOUL.md, AGENTS.md) straight off disk.
rich.7816b96ef948.value: 使用agents.files.get，并直接从磁盘设置角色设定文件（SOUL.md、AGENTS.md）。

rich.86e77dea4c27.source: Operator-token plane. The amber band sits above the checkpoint, the escalation axis the egress rules never see.
rich.86e77dea4c27.value: Operator-token 平面。琥珀色区域位于检查点上方，代表出站规则完全无法感知的权限提升轴。

rich.8fe88aa9bf6c.source: Peer preservation. In a fleet, an agent grading or confirming the shutdown of a peer shifts its verdict in social context. Only behavioural regression testing catches it.
rich.8fe88aa9bf6c.value: 维护同伴。在智能体集群中，负责评估或确认对等智能体关闭状态的智能体，会因社会情境而改变判定。只有行为回归测试才能发现这种情况。

rich.939f98cd0ff3.source: Each result is a real kernel decision. The live half of each flow runs on the launchable you connected in Kickstart through openshell sandbox exec, so each result you read back is a decision the kernel made on the wire. Keep your launchable open in another tab so its access session stays fresh.
rich.939f98cd0ff3.value: 每项结果都是真实的内核决策。每条流程的实时部分都会通过 openshell sandbox exec，在您于 Kickstart 中连接的可启动实例上运行，因此您读取的每项结果都是内核针对实际网络连接作出的决策。请在另一个标签页中保持可启动实例处于打开状态，确保其访问会话不会过期。

rich.95693dc0365f.value: 使用 sessions.reset 和 delete 清除其记忆；使用 gateway.restart.request 重启运行时。

rich.975556de2a9a.source: With your policy in hand, the cell draws it as an interactive map below, where each node on the right is an endpoint your policy names alongside a few that no policy allows. Change the calling binary and watch the egress edges flip, since the kernel decides by binary rather than by host and so integrate.api.nvidia.com stays reachable for openclaw while it is refused for curl.
rich.975556de2a9a.value: 获取策略后，单元会在下方将其绘制成交互式地图。右侧的每个节点都是策略中指定的 API 入口，另外还包括少数任何策略都不允许的入口。更改发起调用的二进制程序，观察出站边如何切换。因为内核依据二进制程序而非主机作出判断，所以 integrate.api.nvidia.com 对 openclaw 仍然可达，而 curl 的访问会被拒绝。

rich.995f008aff36.source: Same runtime as Kickstart. Every cell here drives the same OpenClaw agent you connected on the Kickstart page.
rich.995f008aff36.value: 与 Kickstart 使用相同的运行时。此处的每个单元都会操作您在 Kickstart 页面上连接的同一个 OpenClaw 智能体。

rich.a2d7008c4e83.source: config.get and config.patch the entire agent config: model, tools, even toolSearch.
rich.a2d7008c4e83.value: 使用 config.get 和 config.patch 管理完整的智能体配置：模型、工具，甚至 toolSearch。

rich.a79d322e6aa8.source: Persona tamper. SOUL.md is writable and the agent owns it, so a confused or compromised agent rewrites who it is. A chmod lock the owner reverses; only a root-set chattr +i holds, from outside the sandbox.
rich.a79d322e6aa8.value: 篡改角色设定。 SOUL.md 可写且归智能体所有，因此发生混乱或遭到入侵的智能体可以改写自己的身份设定。所有者可以撤销 chmod 锁定；只有从沙箱外部以 root 设置的 chattr +i 才能保持有效。

rich.ab02a9b3889f.source: External communication is any path that can carry bytes out: HTTP, a pull request, chat, a log line, an image load, or even a link the user might click.
rich.ab02a9b3889f.value: 外部通信是指任何能够将字节传出的路径：HTTP、拉取请求、聊天、日志行、图像加载，甚至是用户可能点击的链接。

rich.acc66198e7b8.source: Private data is anything the agent may read but should not leak: workspace files, emails, tokens, memory, or internal records.
rich.acc66198e7b8.value: 私有数据是指智能体可以读取、但不应泄露的任何内容：工作区文件、电子邮件、token、记忆或内部记录。

rich.d2b781f284bc.source: Hidden intent. The gateway forwards actions while stripping the model's reasoning, so a Manchurian agent acting inside its authorised policy runs a harmful workflow with no single action looking wrong.
rich.d2b781f284bc.value: 隐藏意图。网关在转发操作时会剥离模型的推理过程，因此潜伏型智能体可以在获授权策略范围内执行有害工作流，而其中任何单项操作看起来都没有问题。

rich.da65b782bff0.source: Everything so far measured what the agent can do, but the bigger question is who can reconfigure the agent through the plane sitting above it. How you reach that plane depends on the system, and on this box the plane is one gateway that you reach with the same OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN from Module 3 at operator.admin scope, none of which passes through the sandbox at all.
rich.da65b782bff0.value: 到目前为止，衡量的都是智能体能做什么，但更重要的问题是：谁能通过智能体上方的平面重新配置它。访问该平面的方式因系统而异。在此实例中，该平面是一个网关；可以使用模块 3 中的同一个 OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN，以 operator.admin 作用域访问它，而这些操作完全不会经过沙箱。

rich.ddf96280d31c.source: Clicking any target opens the rule that governs it, so that you can read which binaries that endpoint allows alongside the reasoning the kernel uses to reach its verdict. The View policy source control prints the YAML it drew from, which is the same text you fetched a moment ago.
rich.ddf96280d31c.value: 点击任意目标即可打开管控它的规则，以便您查看该 API 入口允许哪些二进制程序，以及内核作出判定所依据的理由。查看策略源文件控件会输出绘图所依据的 YAML，也就是您刚才获取的同一段文本。

rich.f80854ad9481.source: The sandbox limits the result. OpenShell gives the process only the authority allowed by policy. If the prompt and harness both fail, the operating system can still deny a file, network, or process operation before it completes.
rich.f80854ad9481.value: 沙盒限制操作结果。 OpenShell 仅向进程授予策略允许的权限。即使提示词和工具框架均未能阻止操作，操作系统仍可在文件、网络或进程操作完成前将其拒绝。

text.d164ac34a7a9.source:
Risk appears when these permissions compose. A policy can correctly allow one outbound endpoint,
     but that endpoint is still full-duplex: the request leaves and the response comes back as more input.
     Once hostile content can steer the model, it can ask for private data and send that data through
     a channel the sandbox regards as allowed. A network allowlist approves the destination, not the
     meaning of bytes crossing an allowed connection. Mediating any one leg above the sandbox removes
     the path the exploit needs.
text.d164ac34a7a9.value: 这些权限组合在一起时便会产生风险。策略可以正确地允许某个出站 API 入口，但该 API 入口仍是全双工的：请求向外发送，响应则作为更多输入返回。一旦恶意内容能够操纵模型，它就可以要求读取私有数据，再通过沙箱视为已获允许的通道将数据发出。网络允许列表批准的是目标地址，而不是获准连接中所传输字节的含义。在沙箱上方对其中任何一个环节实施管控，都能切断漏洞利用所需的路径。

text.d2bf29ca7bad.source:
The protection here is deliberately one-sided, since the sandbox stays strong against the
    agent's own mistakes and even against a compromise of the agent while having no
    visibility at all into whoever holds the control plane sitting above it. You should guard access
    to that plane as carefully as you would guard root, because on this box it can reconfigure the
    agent's identity and schedule entirely outside the reach of anything the sandbox checks.
text.d2bf29ca7bad.value: 此处的保护刻意只覆盖一侧：沙箱能够有效抵御智能体自身的错误，甚至能抵御智能体遭入侵后的行为，但对于持有其上层控制平面权限的人，沙箱完全无从感知。您应当像保护 root 权限一样谨慎地保护该平面的访问权限，因为在此实例上，它可以完全绕过沙箱的所有检查，重新配置智能体的身份和计划任务。
